newsitem.title: USA: Xerox offers home/small office product.
newsitem.headline: Xerox offers home/small office product.

text.p: Xerox Corp unveiled on Monday its first household product, priced at $499, that transforms the family personal computer into a combined color scanner, printer and copier.
Called the Document HomeCentre, the company said the integrated, multifunction device is targetted for small and home offices.

The company said it also introduced the Document WorkCentre 450c, also a multifunction system designed for small and home offices. The product integrates color printing with faxing, PC faxing, copying and scanning and has a retail price of about $549, it said.

It said the Document HomeCentre and Document WorkCentre 450c are the first Xerox products that use the color inkjet technology developed at its Webster, N.Y.-based Wilson Research Center. The scanning and document management software technologies that are part of the products originate at its Palo Alto Research Center, it said.

It said the Document HomeCentre will be available at retailers in the U.S. and Canada in early September. It will be available in Europe in the fourth quarter of this year and Latin America in the first quarter of 1998, it said.
The Document WorkCentre 450c will be available at retailers in the U.S. and Canada later this month, and will be in Europe and Latin America in the fourth quarter of this year.
